about: T-412 (the user, 2026-10-16; all twenty-one approved as drafts 2026-10-18, docs/private/drafts-2026-10-16.md section 5): the DREAM LOG's YOUR DREAMS. Images only, no interpretation, first person, present tense; no dream names a place, counts or numbers anything. Each arrives at the first dawn after its milestone (the watch), or on the first load on a later day -- one a night, in this order when several wait -- said after the line below, and is filed in the NOTEBOOK's DREAM LOG. Each box is the draft's own lines, kept where they fit the 208px message box. tools/gbadreamlog.py writes engineGba/src/data/dream_log.h; edit here, never there. Every word DRAFT.
line_about: The draft left 'You had a dream.' or 'I had a dream.' to the user, who chose 'I had a dream.' (2026-10-18): the player says it, first person like the dreams themselves. DRAFT.
title_rule: A page's title in the NOTEBOOK's list is its own "title" -- chosen by the user one by one from the draft's two (2026-10-18, docs/private/draft-dream-titles-and-attendant-2026-10-18.md part 1): ALL CAPS, at most TITLE_W px, an image taken from the dream, never what it stands for, never a number. DRAFT.
headings_about: T-412's two parts. Once the CHECKPOINT attendant has told one of her dreams (T-347; docs/attendant_dreams.json, tools/gbadreams.py), the DREAM LOG's list is headed in two: YOUR DREAMS, then HER DREAMS. A player she never dreamt for sees the list as before, unheaded. DRAFT.

dreams.title: THE CARVED NAME
boxes: A tortoise carves my name into a
stone, slowly, and gets it right.
The rain comes. The letters fill
with water and stay letters.

dreams.title: THE SUNKEN STAIR
boxes: I walk down into a pool. There is
always one more stair under the
water.
A hippo floats at the bottom,
asleep, perfectly still.

dreams.title: THE HUMMING WIRE
boxes: A hare shouts into a telephone
wire. It hums back another word.
He laughs, licks his pencil and
writes the new one down.

dreams.title: THE GLASSHOUSE
boxes: A bird strings blue thread between
every flower in a glasshouse.
When she is done there is one long
line, and a vine already climbing.

dreams.title: CARDS ON EDGE
boxes: A toad deals cards onto a table
and keeps only the highest.
The middle cards stand up on their
edges and walk away together.

dreams.title: THE EMPTY FRAME
boxes: A green lizard holds an empty
frame up. Through it, my room.
She lowers it. The room is bigger,
and has doors I never saw.

dreams.title: COOLING GLASS
boxes: A salamander turns glowing glass
on a long pipe, and turns it.
He sets it down to cool. It cracks
a little, and keeps its shape.

dreams.title: THE SCALES
boxes: A red snake in a grey suit pours
coins into a scale. It balances.
He sets that scale on a bigger
one. That balances too.
Nobody is holding either.

dreams.title: STONE ROOMS
boxes: Stone rooms, one after another,
going down into the hill.
In the last, a word on the wall
that does not fade when I blink.

dreams.title: THE BLACKBOARD
boxes: A blackboard full of names. I rub
one out.
The thing it named stays on the
desk, waiting to be called again.

dreams.title: SHINING PAGES
boxes: A reading room, all the lamps out.
I close my eyes.
When I open them, every page on
every shelf has been shining.

dreams.title: THE MARBLE
boxes: I am a marble rolling round a
bowl. Each turn feels like going.
Then I am the hand above the bowl,
holding it level.

dreams.title: DOWN THE LADDER
boxes: A tall ladder, swaying. I climb
down it instead of up.
Somewhere in the middle I stop,
and the ladder stops too.

dreams.title: KNOTS IN THE FOG
boxes: A rope bridge, cut, its two halves
hanging down into the fog.
Somebody on the far side starts
tying knots. So do I.

dreams.title: EMPTY PAGES
boxes: I close a book. My hands keep
turning pages that are not there.
Then they stop turning, and start
building something.

dreams.after: after the REVIEW BOARD is beaten
dreams.title: CLOSED FILES
boxes: At a long table, four judges close
their files at the same moment.
Behind them a high window, and it
is morning.

dreams.after: after CRYSTAL has gone missing (the same moment, so the next dawn after the BOARD's dream)
dreams.title: A KETTLE BOILED DRY
boxes: A fox's coat on its hook, still
warm. A kettle boiled dry.
A note pinned to the wall. In the
dream I cannot read it.

dreams.after: after TY gives you the note for CRYSTAL
dreams.title: THE PARCEL
boxes: Someone in a long coat holds out a
parcel, and does not let go.
Then he does. It is lighter than
it looked, and warm on one side.

dreams.title: A BREATHING STAR
boxes: Deep in a cave, a star the size of
a hand, breathing slowly.
I hold out a BOX. The star looks
at it, then at me, and climbs in.

dreams.after: after the OWL concedes and S.T.A.R.R. is bound (it takes you to CRYSTAL)
dreams.title: SEALING WAX
boxes: An owl signs a letter, folds it,
and seals it with wax.
Then I am high over the sea at
night, holding on to a star.
Below, one window is lit.

dreams.after: after CRYSTAL is free and home
dreams.title: THE WINDOWSILL
boxes: A fox in a lab coat is watering
the plants on a windowsill.
The kettle is on. Every colour in
the room is where it was.
